issues.name: Frequent and loud advertisements and limited playback controls
issues.description: Customers experience excessive and loud advertisements and struggle with limited playback controls, including difficulty skipping songs or navigating specific parts of a track.

issues.name: General dissatisfaction with the app
issues.description: Customers are expressing overall disappointment and frustration with the app, particularly following recent updates.

issues.name: App instability and playback interruptions
issues.description: The app crashes, gets stuck on loading screens, fails to connect to the internet, and stops playing music mid-song.

issues.name: Restricted playback controls for non-premium users
issues.description: Users are unable to skip songs, select specific tracks, or go back to previous songs without a premium subscription.

issues.name: Missing songs and inconsistent lyrics availability
issues.description: Customers encounter missing songs and find that lyrics are sometimes unavailable or inconsistent across different tracks.

issues.name: Inability to log in to accounts
issues.description: Customers are unable to access their accounts because the app will not accept their passwords.

issues.name: Offline mode and downloads not working
issues.description: Users are unable to listen to their music while offline.

issues.name: Rude support staff
issues.description: Customers find the support representatives to be rude.
